name: Supply market data for the assets a business holds, trades or reports on
outcome: When a valuation, a trade, a report or an agent's decision needs the price, volume or market history of an asset, the figure is available at the freshness the use requires, from a source that can be named and re-queried, with the venue, the time and the currency it was quoted in.
description: The data supply behind finance work, not the finance work: a treasury valuing what it holds, a controller closing the books, a trading or pricing decision, an agent that must know what something costs before it acts. Covers listed securities, currencies, commodities and crypto assets, including onchain pools and tokens. Claimed by a data vendor whose product delivers the figures over an API, a feed or an MCP server, and by an agent whose work depends on quoting them. It is not fin.reconcile-accounts or fin.forecast-cash (which consume prices), not proc.compare-supplier-quotes (bids, not markets), and not eng.retrieve-reference-context (documentation, not data). A claim names the asset classes and the delivery paths the vendor documents; a keyless or machine-payable path is an access or payments fact, recorded there.
measures: freshness of a quoted price against the venue it came from
coverage of the assets the business needs, as a share
share of price requests answered within the required latency
share of figures traceable to a named venue, time and quote currency
